intent: The right-rail access seam: a fixed-width aside with an Inspector / Agent tab header. The host controls which view is visible; each child owns its internal navigation.
use_when: Switching the right rail between the inspector and an agent view.
You want the canonical rail chrome (Tabs header + tabpanel) without owning it.
dont_use_when: A left-rail destination switch — use NavRail.

a11y.role: complementary (aside) with a Tabs header (tablist) over a tabpanel body.
a11y.tabs: uses the real Tabs primitive — roving focus + aria-controls.
